Load Data

  data <- rio::import("https://github.com/Rkzz-dr/mpdw/raw/main/Data/dataset%20pm2.5%20(Data%20Kelompok).xlsx", which = 5)
head(data)
##      tanggal            stasiun pm25
## 1 2024-04-16 DKI1 (Bunderan HI)   52
## 2 2024-04-17 DKI1 (Bunderan HI)   69
## 3 2024-04-18 DKI1 (Bunderan HI)   60
## 4 2024-04-19 DKI1 (Bunderan HI)   60
## 5 2024-04-20 DKI1 (Bunderan HI)   77
## 6 2024-04-21 DKI1 (Bunderan HI)   52
data.ts <- ts(data$pm25)

ts.plot(data.ts, xlab="Time Period ", ylab="pm25", 
        main = "Time Series Plot")
points(data.ts)

Pembagian Data

# hitung jumlah data
n <- nrow(data)

# tentukan batas 80%
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n)

# bagi data
training_ma <- data[1:n_train, ]
testing_ma  <- data[(n_train+1):n, ]

# ubah ke time series
train.ts <- ts(training_ma$pm25)
test.ts  <- ts(testing_ma$pm25)

str(train.ts)
##  Time-Series [1:124] from 1 to 124: 52 69 60 60 77 52 71 70 71 69 ...
str(test.ts)
##  Time-Series [1:31] from 1 to 31: 93 86 93 96 84 77 98 90 78 106 ...

Akurasi Data Latih

error_train.sma = train.ts-data.ramal[1:length(train.ts)]

SSE_train.sma = sum(error_train.sma[8:length(train.ts)]^2)
MSE_train.sma = mean(error_train.sma[8:length(train.ts)]^2)
MAPE_train.sma = mean(abs((error_train.sma[8:length(train.ts)]/train.ts[8:length(train.ts)])*100))

akurasi_train.sma <- matrix(c(SSE_train.sma, MSE_train.sma, MAPE_train.sma))
row.names(akurasi_train.sma)<- c("SSE", "MSE", "MAPE")
colnames(akurasi_train.sma) <- c("Akurasi m = 7")
akurasi_train.sma
##      Akurasi m = 7
## SSE    21923.14286
## MSE      187.37729
## MAPE      14.28167

Akurasi Data Uji

error_test.sma = test.ts-data.gab[125:155,3]

SSE_test.sma = sum(error_test.sma^2)
MSE_test.sma = mean(error_test.sma^2)
MAPE_test.sma = mean(abs((error_test.sma/test.ts*100)))

akurasi_test.sma <- matrix(c(SSE_test.sma, MSE_test.sma, MAPE_test.sma))
row.names(akurasi_test.sma)<- c("SSE", "MSE", "MAPE")
colnames(akurasi_test.sma) <- c("Akurasi m = 7")
akurasi_test.sma
##      Akurasi m = 7
## SSE     4194.53061
## MSE      135.30744
## MAPE      12.17759

Double Moving Average (DMA)

dma <- SMA(data.sma, n = 7)
At <- 2*data.sma - dma
Bt <- 2/(4-1)*(data.sma - dma)
data.dma<- At+Bt
data.ramal2<- c(NA, data.dma)

t = 1:31
f = c()

for (i in t) {
  f[i] = At[length(At)] + Bt[length(Bt)]*(i)
}

data.gab2 <- cbind(aktual = c(data.ts), 
                   pemulusan1 = c(data.sma,rep(NA,31)),
                   pemulusan2 = c(dma, rep(NA,31)),
                   At = c(At, rep(NA,31)), 
                   Bt = c(Bt,rep(NA,31)),
                   ramalan = c(data.ramal2, f[-1]))
data.gab2

Akurasi Data Latih

error_train.dma = train.ts-data.ramal2[1:length(train.ts)]

SSE_train.dma = sum(error_train.dma[14:length(train.ts)]^2)
MSE_train.dma = mean(error_train.dma[14:length(train.ts)]^2)
MAPE_train.dma = mean(abs((error_train.dma[14:length(train.ts)]/train.ts[14:length(train.ts)])*100))

akurasi_train.dma <- matrix(c(SSE_train.dma, MSE_train.dma, MAPE_train.dma))
row.names(akurasi_train.dma)<- c("SSE", "MSE", "MAPE")
colnames(akurasi_train.dma) <- c("Akurasi m = 7")
akurasi_train.dma
##      Akurasi m = 7
## SSE    35648.94067
## MSE      321.16163
## MAPE      18.23785

Akurasi Data Uji

# Jumlah observasi data uji (menggunakan length untuk objek time series)
n_test <- length(test.ts)

# Error (ramalan - aktual)
e1   <- as.numeric(ramalan1$mean)[1:n_test] - as.numeric(test.ts)
e2   <- as.numeric(ramalan2$mean)[1:n_test] - as.numeric(test.ts)
eopt <- as.numeric(ramalanopt$mean)[1:n_test] - as.numeric(test.ts)

# SSE / MSE / RMSE untuk masing-masing model
SSEtesting1  <- sum(e1^2,  na.rm = TRUE)
MSEtesting1  <- mean(e1^2, na.rm = TRUE)
RMSEtesting1 <- sqrt(MSEtesting1)

SSEtesting2  <- sum(e2^2,  na.rm = TRUE)
MSEtesting2  <- mean(e2^2, na.rm = TRUE)
RMSEtesting2 <- sqrt(MSEtesting2)

SSEtestingopt  <- sum(eopt^2,  na.rm = TRUE)
MSEtestingopt  <- mean(eopt^2, na.rm = TRUE)
RMSEtestingopt <- sqrt(MSEtestingopt)

# Tabel ringkas
akurasitesting_SSE <- matrix(c(SSEtesting1, SSEtesting2, SSEtestingopt),
                             nrow = 3,
                             dimnames = list(c("SSE1","SSE2","SSEopt"), "Nilai"))
akurasitesting_MSE <- matrix(c(MSEtesting1, MSEtesting2, MSEtestingopt),
                             nrow = 3,
                             dimnames = list(c("MSE1","MSE2","MSEopt"), "Nilai"))
akurasitesting_RMSE <- matrix(c(RMSEtesting1, RMSEtesting2, RMSEtestingopt),
                              nrow = 3,
                              dimnames = list(c("RMSE1","RMSE2","RMSEopt"), "Nilai"))

SSEtesting1<-sum(selisih1^2)
MSEtesting1<-SSEtesting1/nrow(testing_df)

forecast1.opt_df<-data.frame(forecast1.opt)
selisih1.opt<-forecast1.opt_df[,1]-testing_df[,1]

MSEtesting1.opt<-SSEtesting1.opt/nrow(testing_df)
akurasi_testing <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Model1", "Model Optimum"),

)
